shadow.beyondsolo.unlocked.body: The dead answer you now. Stand over what you fell and press H to extract its shadow. Your steed Duskmane waits: press Y.
shadow.beyondsolo.fallen.body: %s sinks back into your shadow. It can be called again in %s s.
shadow.beyondsolo.army_full.body: It holds %s shadows. Grow stronger, or release one in the Shadows tab.
shadow.beyondsolo.not_necromancer.body: Only a Necromancer can call on shadows.
shadow.beyondsolo.none_ready.body: They are all out already, or still recovering.
shadow.beyondsolo.none_ready.empty: Your army is empty. Defeat a creature and extract its shadow while its soul lingers.
shadow.beyondsolo.limit.body: You can hold %s shadows in the world at once.
shadow.beyondsolo.no_mount.body: Extract a shadow from a horse, camel, spider or ravager, or wait for your mount to recover.
shadows.beyondsolo.empty: No shadows yet. Defeat a creature, stand over its lingering soul and press the raise key to extract it.
shadows.beyondsolo.does.warrior: Fights up close. Attacks whatever hurts you, whatever you hurt, and monsters near you. Its hits leave the shadow element.
shadows.beyondsolo.does.caster: Keeps its distance and hurls bolts of shadow at your enemies.
shadows.beyondsolo.does.mount: Carries you, and jumps high. When nobody rides it, it fights at your side.
shadows.beyondsolo.does.boss: Dread Slam: every few seconds brings its weight down on everything around it. Shadows near it hit 15% harder.
shadow.beyondsolo.promote.not_raiser: Only a Necromancer's shadows can be promoted.
shadow.beyondsolo.promote.top: %1$s is already of the highest rank.
shadow.beyondsolo.promote.monarch_only: Marshal is as high as a hunter's shadows rise. Only a crowned monarch's shadows go further.
shadow.beyondsolo.promote.climbs: %1$s climbs to %2$s by itself as it grows.
shadow.beyondsolo.promote.level: %1$s has to reach level 10 of its rank first.
shadow.beyondsolo.promote.master: A promotion to %2$s needs you at level %3$s.
shadow.beyondsolo.promote.essence: A promotion to %2$s costs %4$s shadow essence. You have %5$s.
shadow.beyondsolo.ready.body: %1$s has reached the top of its rank. Promote it to %2$s in the Shadows tab: it needs you at level %3$s and %4$s shadow essence.
shadow.beyondsolo.name.nothing: It carries no name of yours to take back.
shadow.beyondsolo.name.too_weak: Only a Knight or stronger, or a boss's shadow, can take a name.
shadow.beyondsolo.name.unfit: A name needs %1$s to %2$s letters (spaces, ' and - are allowed too).
shadow.beyondsolo.name.taken: Another of your shadows already answers to that name.
shadow.beyondsolo.name.slots: You can give names to %3$s shadows. Take a name back first, or grow stronger.
shadow.beyondsolo.named.body: %s will answer to %s from now on. Bound closer to you, it is 10%% stronger.
shadow.beyondsolo.hud.promoted.leads: LEADS THE SHADOWS AROUND IT  ·  POWER  x%s
shadows.beyondsolo.filter.none: No shadows here. Try another filter.
shadows.beyondsolo.sort.name: NAME
shadows.beyondsolo.why.level: It has to reach level 10 of its rank first.
shadows.beyondsolo.why.essence: %2$s more essence. Souls you leave to fade drift into your shadow as essence.
shadows.beyondsolo.promote.capped: Marshal is as high as a hunter's shadows rise. A crowned monarch's go further.
shadows.beyondsolo.leads: Leads the shadows near it: they hit %s%% harder.
shadows.beyondsolo.moves.fly: It flies: hovers over your head and swoops on what you fight.
shadows.beyondsolo.moves.swim: It swims through water and air alike, low over the ground.
shadows.beyondsolo.name.too_weak: Only a Knight or stronger takes a name
shadows.beyondsolo.name.slots: All %s names are given. Take one back, or grow stronger.
title.beyondsolo.keeper_of_names.desc: Give one of your shadows a name.
title.beyondsolo.marshal_maker.desc: Promote one of your shadows to Marshal.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.shadow.list: Lists a player's shadows with their numbers, ranks and levels, and their essence and names.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.shadow.prom: Promotes one of a player's shadows at once (no essence or level needed).
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.shadow.name: Names one of a player's shadows (quotes round a name with spaces; "" takes the name back).
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.shadow.esse: Sets or adds to a player's shadow essence, for promotions.
command.beyondsolo.solo.shadow.list.name: [named]
command.beyondsolo.solo.error.shadow_top: %s is already as high as it can go (%s).
